title: Compute exact rational polynomial-weight sums on fixed-dimensional lattice cells
statement: For bounded rational lattice polytope K and rational polynomial P, compute M(K,P)=sum_(z in K intersect Z^k) P(z) using a fixed-dimensional short rational generating function. Apply products of Euler operators (t_i d/dt_i)^alpha_i for each monomial, combine linearly, and evaluate at t=1 through finite Laurent expansions of order at most deg P+k. Pole cancellation yields the exact finite rational sum. The supplied standard fixed-dimensional Barvinok procedure and rational arithmetic have polynomial bit cost in the polytope description, degree and coefficient height; k and matrices are fixed in Theta. Added coordinate cuts use the same routine, so all conditional cumulative masses for binary splitting are paid computations. This is mature algorithmic machinery used explicitly, not a newly supplied exact-counting oracle or a claim of polynomial complexity in varying dimension.
